set.body: A new project must configure its first analysis without inventing a saved base revision. DraftOrigin.Initial carries the explicit admitted dataset, seed recipe and studio fields; DraftOrigin.Existing carries a real saved revision. DraftContext resolves effective values for both. StartAnalysis creates only a working draft; Save & run creates the first saved revision and run. Reverting initial field edits keeps the unsaved initial draft. Existing draft wire bytes stay unchanged, while initial origin requires new conditional document/science/journal schema versions whose older readers/writers refuse it.
set.title: Decision: first analysis has an initial draft origin
